notablePrerequisites:
Undercity Scrounger does not have summoning sickness.

description:
Activate Undercity Scrounger by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Undercity Scrounger.
Repeat.
